method: 指定 Wiki 的實際瀏覽器頁面、檔案歷史與修訂永久連結；補充有日期的玩家原始討論。未進入遊戲驗證，未將社群說法提升為官方規則。

mechanics.summaryEn: Seven path definitions, exact hex cells, allowed rarities and rarity-based rewards are available in the PC v2.0.2 community data export.
mechanics.summaryZh: PC v2.0.2 社群資料匯出收錄七條路徑的精確六角格、允許品質與指定品質的獎勵。

steps.en: Cover all highlighted cells with upgrades of the listed rarity. Grey reference cells may also be covered (community guide explanation).
steps.zh: 用符合品質的配件覆蓋全部亮色格；灰色參考格也可覆蓋（依社群作者說明）。

steps.en: Path 0, 1, 4 and 5 accept all rarities; Path 2 requires Rare; Path 3 requires Epic; Path 6 accepts Standard or Rare.
steps.zh: Path 0、1、4、5 不限品質；Path 2 限 Rare；Path 3 限 Epic；Path 6 可用 Standard 或 Rare。

steps.en: The guide author reports that claims are shared across gear and each path rewards only once. This runtime behavior was not independently tested.
steps.zh: 攻略作者回報各裝備共用領取進度，每條路徑僅領一次；此執行行為尚未由本站實測。

additionalSources.title: Everything there is to know about HIDDEN PATHS!
additionalSources.author: slidedrum
additionalSources.evidence: Author says path claims are shared across grids and suggests shifting one tile for a historical indexing bug.

mechanics.limitsEn: Data definitions checked; not retested in game. Absolute gear slots, rotation, reflection and translation acceptance are not established by this export. Historical videos target v1.0.3.
mechanics.limitsZh: 已核對資料定義，未實機重測；匯出資料無法確認固定面板插槽、旋轉、鏡射或平移的判定。歷史影片適用 v1.0.3。

checks.title: Secrets & Weapon Unlocks
checks.author: the dragon mom
checks.resultZh: 原始攻略確實提及在升級排列系統覆蓋隱藏路徑會獲得配件，但該段沒有路徑圖形或座標。

checks.title: Hidden Paths: Unlock Upgrade Patterns
checks.resultZh: 只有文字及獎勵表，沒有可核對的路徑格形。其第7條稀有度敘述與近期原始玩家討論不一致，且表格漏列自己所說的Epic路徑，故不採為精確配方證據。
可讀評論確認共用與早期位移排錯，未能取得可逐格核對的原始影片圖樣。

followupResearch.limitsZh: 保留前一輪未取得圖樣的搜尋紀錄。2026-10-24 已改由具版本與雜湊的遊戲資料匯出核對七條路徑，舊搜尋結論不代表目前的收錄狀態。

mechanics.summaryEn: The Wiki places Pattern Infuser access at player level 13. Infusion changes an upgrade pattern and spends Antimass Substrate; it is separate from receiving a Hidden Path reward.
mechanics.summaryZh: Wiki 記載 Pattern Infuser 在玩家等級 13 解鎖。灌注用於改變升級配件格形，消耗 Antimass Substrate；它與隱藏路徑送出的解鎖獎勵是不同機制。

steps.en: Reach player level 13 to access the Pattern Infuser. The Cycler page independently lists the same player-level requirement for pattern infusion on that weapon.
steps.zh: 先達到玩家等級 13。The Cycler 條目也獨立列出此武器格形灌注的相同玩家等級門檻。

steps.en: The documented cost is max(10 + cellDifference × 5, 1) + targetRarity × 2 Antimass Substrate. The Wiki describes cellDifference as the difference in cell counts and targetRarity as Standard = 0 through Contraband = 5.
steps.zh: Wiki 列出的 Antimass Substrate 費用公式為 max(10 + cellDifference × 5, 1) + targetRarity × 2；cellDifference 是兩配件占格數差，targetRarity 從 Standard = 0 到 Contraband = 5。

steps.en: The separate Pattern Inheriting article discusses Interim Manager and Fake ID in Ouroboros. Do not treat those mode-specific pickups as the general Pattern Infuser unlock condition.
steps.zh: 另一篇 Pattern Inheriting 講的是 Ouroboros 模式的 Interim Manager、Fake ID 拾取效果；不應把該模式的拾取物當成一般 Pattern Infuser 的解鎖條件。

mechanics.limitsEn: The checked pages do not label these mechanics with a game version. The cost section does not explicitly state which operand is subtracted from which in cellDifference. Donor eligibility, item consumption, and changes to stat scaling are not established by these passages; confirm the in-game preview before paying.
mechanics.limitsZh: 已核對段落沒有註明適用遊戲版本。費用段落未明說 cellDifference 的相減方向；可用供體條件、是否消耗物品及改形後的數值縮放，也不能由這幾段文字確定，實際支付前應核對遊戲內預覽。

mechanics.summaryEn: The Cycler Wiki page lists rewards earned by leveling this weapon. This gear progression is separate from player level 13 unlocking Pattern Infusion.
mechanics.summaryZh: The Cycler 的 Wiki 條目列有武器升級獎勵。此處是該武器的裝備等級，與玩家等級 13 解鎖格形灌注的進度分開。

steps.en: Gear levels 3, 5 and 7 award an upgrade from a curated set. Level 10 awards an Epic upgrade; level 12 awards an Exotic upgrade.
steps.zh: 裝備等級 3、5、7 各可獲得指定候選池中的升級；等級 10 為 Epic 升級、等級 12 為 Exotic 升級。

steps.en: The table also lists a Rare skin at level 2, an Epic skin at level 9, one Saxonite at level 15, and an Oddity upgrade at level 32.
steps.zh: 表中另列等級 2 的 Rare 外觀、等級 9 的 Epic 外觀、等級 15 的 1 Saxonite，以及等級 32 的 Oddity 升級。

mechanics.limitsEn: This is the checked Cycler table, not a verified universal schedule for every weapon, employee, or grenade. It does not name the level-32 Oddity or document grid expansion at levels 3, 6 and 10. No game version is specified and no in-game test was performed.
mechanics.limitsZh: 此處只代表已核對的 Cycler 表，不是所有武器、角色、手榴彈通用且經驗證的進度表。原表沒有指定等級 32 的 Oddity 名稱，也未記載等級 3、6、10 擴格；不從其他攻略傳言補上。來源未註明遊戲版本，本站未實機驗證。

upgrades.conditionZh: 已核對的 Wiki 修訂將取得來源列為世界掉落池，未提供面板擺放配方。

upgrades.limitsZh: 工作簿首頁雖有 Pulverizer Unlock 標題，但沒有文字條件；舊版特殊解鎖與正式版是否相同，仍待核對。

upgrades.conditionEn: The checked Wiki revision lists the world drop pool as its source. Its bordering-prism description is an installed effect, not an acquisition condition.
upgrades.conditionZh: 已核對的 Wiki 修訂將取得來源列為世界掉落池。「與其他稜鏡相鄰而遞迴提高輸出」屬安裝效果，並非取得條件。
upgrades.versionEvidence: Acquisition section does not state a game version. Changelog headings are not treated as acquisition-version guarantees.
upgrades.limitsEn: This one revision does not establish the original prism quest or whether every other prism has the same acquisition route.
upgrades.limitsZh: 此一修訂不足以確認最初的稜鏡解鎖任務，也不能據此推定其他顏色稜鏡都使用相同取得條件。
